order: Dataset publisher order; first arm alternates by dataset index; reverse that order on repeat 2. Run both variants for every dataset/arm/repeat.
task: One circle marker at the complete-data mean with a vertical +/- sample SD interval, separate figures in original publisher units, descriptive only. Title contains dataset ID and mean/sample SD meaning; labelled axes. Missing-interval sentinel intentionally violates this same task in both arms.

accuracy.reference: External NIST certified mean, sample SD and their decimal endpoints. Lag1 is metadata only.
accuracy.reference_quantum: Zero for exact values; otherwise one unit in the last printed decimal place (conservative rounding/truncation allowance).
accuracy.input_error: Maximum abs(Decimal.from_float(float(token))-Decimal(token)) over the original decimal tokens.
accuracy.half_span_allowance: Average of the two endpoint allowances; half-span is measured from actual plotted endpoints, not an underlying SD estimator.
accuracy.interpretation: Engineering gates with explicit float/printed-precision context; not NIST software certification or a proof of every estimator. Retain continuous deviations and every failed/missing result.

quality: Decode actual PNG/SVG/one-page PDF, require one measured save of each and unchanged final bytes, or native static SVG graphic-DOM identity under accessibility-only additions and path whitespace normalization. Score marker/interval presence and within-axes center/endpoints, >=2px interval and >=6pt text at 3.4in placement. Record text-overlap candidates separately for visual review; proxies do not establish human aesthetics/usefulness. Require captured PNG save-DPI and decoded DPI metadata to match the declared150dpi (metadata rounding allowance0.5dpi).
reproducibility: Both repetitions must have decodable actual PNGs; compare dimensions+RGBA pixels within each arm/variant/case. Missing outputs fail comparability, never count as identical. Cross-renderer pixels need not agree.
timing: Record machine producer/build, process wall, instrumented script execution and file-save seconds separately. Do not subtract measurement overhead or infer human authoring time.

development_sessions.operator: One coding assistant in this thread; unblinded, already familiar with both workflows, no human participant.
development_sessions.task: Author each arm-specific producer from an absent file to verified correct clean outputs for all nine datasets, using the shared frozen measurement harness. Producer accepts dataset, CSV, output directory and missing-interval variant and writes figure.py (and its own declarative payload if any).
development_sessions.clock: Append UTC/monotonic begin event before further producer-specific lookup/editing; end after first correct nine-case verification. Include failed attempts/tool/validation time. Keep all events/failed outputs; no retrospective reconstructed times.
development_sessions.order: Matplotlib producer first, GraphUnslopify second. Fixed order, shared prior work and one operator prevent a causal speed/productivity claim.
development_sessions.shared_cost: Report shared measurement/harness code size and preparation separately. Common prior work is excluded from per-arm sessions and must be disclosed, together with producer/payload/generated-code sizes. Prior design/familiarity time is unmeasured and excluded; session clocks cover producer implementation/revision to successful verification, not total project development.
development_sessions.unmeasured: Human development time, researcher quality/usability and independent external study execution.

failure_policy: Freeze protocol and measurement implementation in Git before any NIST tool-output evaluation. Retain all nine cases, variants, repeats, logs/statuses/hashes and failures. A subsequent protocol change needs a new version and retained earlier outcomes.

amendment.reason: V1 incorrectly rejected GraphUnslopify SVG record_output accessibility/path-whitespace postprocessing despite unchanged graphics. All v1 outcomes and producer versions are retained.
amendment.numeric_and_physical_gates: Unchanged from v1; no dataset, variant, repeat or error threshold removed/tuned.
amendment.formal_benchmark: No formal72-run comparison executed before this amendment. New formal comparison reruns both arms under v2.
amendment.development_timing: GraphUnslopify clock continues without reset and includes shared evaluator repair/waiting; its elapsed time cannot support a paired workflow-authoring-speed claim.
